recipe.attribution: Credit the REX3 and GHG extension authors, retain source attribution and indicate changes. The pinned REX3 releases have their own terms, separate from standard EXIOBASE releases.
recipe.ghg_note: Source-characterised REX3 climate impacts, detailed coal/oil/gas/biogenic/calcination accounts and LULUCF once; overlapping climate totals are excluded. Direct final-demand LULUCF enters once. GHG source: https://zenodo.org/records/14724086.
recipe.final_demand_note: REX3 supplies one native final-demand category per destination region. Separate SNA consumption and capital-formation categories are unavailable; only Total is compared.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. REX3 supplies one native final-demand category per destination region. Separate SNA consumption and capital-formation categories are unavailable; only Total is compared. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.

direct_flow_validation.scope_note: The small source slice validates only direct trade aggregation. It is never solved as an MRIO or used for emissions.

metric_methods.gross_output: Released MARIO public APIs; native IOT/SUT blocks and region aggregation
metric_methods.domestic_use: Released MARIO public APIs; native IOT/SUT blocks and region aggregation
